# pbs_remote_datastores (Data Source)

Lists the datastores of a remote: PBS signs in to the remote with its credentials and lists the datastores its `auth_id` may see there. Reading it fails when the remote cannot be reached or refuses the credentials, so it doubles as a check of a `pbs_remote` — for one in the same configuration, refer to its `name`, so that the scan waits for it. Needs `Remote.Audit` on `/remote/<remote>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# PBS signs in to the remote to list its datastores, so reading this fails
# when the remote's host, fingerprint or credentials are wrong. Referring to
# the name of pbs_remote.offsite, of the pbs_remote example, reads it after
# the remote is created or changed.
data "pbs_remote_datastores" "offsite" {
  remote = pbs_remote.offsite.name
}

# The datastore the offsite sync job pushes to must be there, and writable.
check "offsite_datastore_is_ready" {
  assert {
    condition = anytrue([
      for ds in data.pbs_remote_datastores.offsite.datastores :
      ds.store == "offsite1" && ds.maintenance_mode == null
    ])
    error_message = "The offsite PBS has no datastore offsite1 that sync@pbs!primary may see, or it is in maintenance mode."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `remote` (String) Name of the remote to scan, such as the `name` of a `pbs_remote`.

### Read-Only

- `datastores` (Attributes List) The remote's datastores, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--datastores))

<a id="nestedatt--datastores"></a>
### Nested Schema for `datastores`

Read-Only:

- `backend_type` (String) `filesystem`, or `s3` for a datastore on S3.
- `comment` (String) Comment; null when there is none.
- `maintenance_mode` (Attributes) The datastore's maintenance mode; null when there is none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--datastores--maintenance_mode))
- `mount_status` (String) `mounted` or `notmounted` for a removable datastore, `nonremovable` for any other.
- `store` (String) Datastore name, as `remote_store` of a `pbs_sync_job` takes it.

<a id="nestedatt--datastores--maintenance_mode"></a>
### Nested Schema for `datastores.maintenance_mode`

Read-Only:

- `message` (String) Message; null when there is none.
- `type` (String) `read-only`, `offline`, or a mode PBS sets itself: `delete`, `unmount` or `s3-refresh`.
